workout_1.title: Power & recovery (Tue)
workout_1.description:
Recovery day after Monday training.

5 min warm-up: Dynamic stretches, arm circles.

Jump prep: 3×8 jump squats (focus on landing soft).

Legs: 3×10 single-leg RDL each leg, 3×15 calf raises.

Core: 3×30s side plank each side, 3×10 bird dogs.

Cool-down: 5 min stretch (hamstrings, hip flexors, shoulders).

workout_2.title: Upper body & core (Wed)
workout_2.description:
Prep for Thursday training.

5 min warm-up: Jog, arm circles, band pull-aparts.

Push-ups: 3×8–12 (or pike push-ups for overhead strength).

Shoulder stability: 3×10 Y–T–W raises (light weight or band).

Core: 3×20 Russian twists, 3×30s hollow hold.

Cool-down: 5 min stretch (chest, shoulders, lats).

workout_3.title: Weekend – full body & mobility
workout_3.description:
Longer session when you have more time.

10 min warm-up: Jog, dynamic stretches, arm circles, leg swings.

Full body: 3×10 squats, 3×8 push-ups, 3×10 single-leg RDL each leg.

Mobility: 2×10 hip circles each direction, 2×10 shoulder dislocates (band or towel).

Core: 3×30s plank, 3×10 bird dogs.

Cool-down: 5–10 min stretch (full body).

2025-01-27.title: Light core & mobility
2025-01-27.description:
5 min warm-up (jog on the spot, arm circles).

Core: 3×10 crunches, 3×30s plank.

Mobility: 2×10 leg swings each leg, 2×10 hip circles each direction.

Cool-down: 2 min stretch (quads, hamstrings, shoulders).

2025-01-28.title: Legs & balance
2025-01-28.description:
5 min warm-up.

Squats: 3×12 bodyweight squats.

Balance: 3×30s single-leg stand each leg.

Calf raises: 3×15.

Cool-down: 2 min stretch.

2025-01-29.title: Upper body & shoulders
2025-01-29.description:
5 min warm-up.

Push-ups: 3×8 (or knee push-ups).

Shoulder mobility: arm circles, band or towel stretches.

Cool-down: 2 min stretch.
